name: Metro Nature in Neighborhoods Community Stewardship and Restoration Grants
summary: Grants from the Portland-area regional government for community-led habitat restoration and stewardship projects on public or protected land, requiring partnerships of at least three organisations.

amount.note: Small grants up to $50,000, medium up to $75,000, large up to $100,000.

status.quote: Tuesday, April 21st, 2026 Final applications due to Metro by 4 p.m.

deadline.quote: Pre-applications are due by 4 p.m. February 10, 2026.

pool.quote: Members of the review committee will help to allocate up to $750,000 in community stewardship and restoration grants

applicant_types.quote: Community groups, watershed councils, neighborhood associations, nonprofits, faith groups and service groups with nonprofit or other tax-exempt status may apply.

geography.quote: Grants may only be awarded to projects and programs that benefit Metro-area residents.

access.quote: Make an appointment to talk with the program manager.

window.quote: These grants are currently offered every other year; this is the second community stewardship and restoration grant opportunity of the 2022 levy renewal.

amount.quote: Small grants have a maximum award of $50,000, medium grants have a maximum award of $75,000, and large grants have a maximum award of $100,000.

consortium_required.quote: this grant program requires each application to have at least three partners (including the lead applicant).
